INSERT INTO security_daily_prices (security_id, trade_date, open_price, close_price, high_price, low_price, volume) VALUES
(#{r.securityId}, #{r.tradeDate}, #{r.openPrice}, #{r.closePrice}, #{r.highPrice}, #{r.lowPrice}, #{r.volume})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE open_price = VALUES(open_price), close_price = VALUES(close_price), high_price = VALUES(high_price), low_price = VALUES(low_price), volume = VALUES(volume)
